info.name: BidNest — E-commerce API (dev3)
info.description:
BidNest e-commerce API test suite

AUTH-008 — every request that is not @Public needs a real bearer token.
Run `pnpm --dir apps/api exec prisma db seed`, then copy the tokens it prints
into the adminToken / sellerAToken / sellerBToken / buyerToken variables
of the 'BidNest local' environment (they expire per JWT_ACCESS_TTL, 15 minutes by default)

Select the 'BidNest local' environment before sending, then Run the collection from folder 00 down.
Folder 07 Negative must run after 03/04/05, because it uses ids those folders saved.

Before running: docker compose up -d, prisma migrate dev, prisma db seed, pnpm dev:api
